item: R826 stage 2: corpus segments are opened read-only and checked before use
summary: A segment file in the data folder's corpus folder opens only as a single-named regular file, read-only through the app's factory with the corpus key, encrypted exactly as the shared file is, hardened before any row is read, with a schema exactly what this build makes and a recorded identity matching its registry row; otherwise it is segment N unavailable with a fixed reason code. Segments open in the background newest first and /api/health reports N of M once one exists; disposal closes them. Writing segment files stays behind an off switch nothing turns on. No corpus has a segment yet, so nothing changes for users.
